tickets.subject: Another alert rule affected
tickets.body: Turns out it wasn't just the one rule - a second alert has also reverted to default settings. Might be worth checking all of ours rather than fixing them one at a time as we find them.

tickets.subject: Exports down - new incident
tickets.body: Different issue this time - exports are failing again, now with a timeout error rather than the blank-file issue from November. Please look into it.

tickets.subject: Dashboards not loading, same morning as exports
tickets.body: Dashboards have also gone down this morning, same time as the export issue I just reported. Might be related, might not - flagging both.

tickets.subject: Second export failure today
tickets.body: Exports failed again a few hours after the earlier fix today. Please check whatever was patched actually held.

tickets.subject: Alerts silent since yesterday's issues
tickets.body: Following yesterday's export and dashboard problems, alerts have now gone quiet too. Feels like a rough week across the board.

tickets.subject: Exports failing a third time this week
tickets.body: Exports down again - third time this week. I know you always get these fixed fast, but the frequency itself is becoming the issue.

tickets.subject: API integration down
tickets.body: API integration stopped working overnight, first issue we've had in a while. Usual quick fix appreciated.

tickets.subject: Connector sync stopped
tickets.body: Our main data connector has stopped syncing as of this morning - dashboards are showing yesterday's numbers. Please take a look.

tickets.subject: Connector down again, three days later
tickets.body: Same connector is down again, just three days after the last fix. Would help to know if this is a recurring root cause rather than a one-off each time.

tickets.subject: API rate limits ahead of year-end close
tickets.body: As we head into year-end reporting, I wanted to check what our current API rate limits are under the Professional plan. We're planning to pull larger batches of historical data for a consolidation exercise in January and want to make sure we don't hit throttling mid-run. Could you confirm the request-per-minute ceiling and whether it's possible to request a temporary increase for the last week of December? Happy to provide more detail on the specific endpoints we'd be using. Thanks, Kristina

tickets.subject: Recurring API timeouts on scheduled pulls
tickets.body: We're seeing intermittent timeout errors on our scheduled API pulls again — similar rate-limit territory to what Kristina raised back in December, though this time it's timing out rather than throttling outright. It's happening roughly two to three times a week, usually on the larger endpoint calls, and we're having to re-run manually when it does. Could someone check whether the rate-limit increase from December is still in place? Log excerpts from the last two failures are attached. Regards, Liisa Johansson, Head of Operations

tickets.subject: Connector mapping issue after source system update
tickets.body: Our accounting system had a scheduled update last week and since then the data connector has been mapping two of the cost-centre fields incorrectly, which is throwing off the departmental breakdowns. Could someone take a look at the field mapping for our connector? Separately, and unrelated to this specific issue, as part of next year's tooling review we've been asked to take a look at Dashlume alongside our renewal, so if there's anything worth knowing about the roadmap for connector reliability, I'd welcome the context. Kristina

tickets.subject: Dashboard load times still slow on the operations view
tickets.body: The operations dashboard is still taking upwards of thirty seconds to load most mornings, which we first mentioned informally a while back. It's not broken exactly, just slow enough that a couple of the team have started pulling the numbers from the scheduled export instead of opening the live view. No particular urgency on our end since the workaround is holding up fine, but wanted it on record in case it's part of a wider pattern you're tracking. Liisa
